# Super Easy QR Code Generator

> Free, browser-based QR code generator with logo overlay and UTM campaign tracking. Nothing is uploaded to a server. This file describes only the tool at https://nuung.github.io/qrcode-gen/.

## What it does
- Encodes any landing page URL into a QR code, previewed live in the page
- Builds the UTM-tagged URL for you from the campaign fields, or from a preset (Facebook, Newsletter, Print, YouTube)
- Places an uploaded logo over the middle of the code and lets you resize it
- Lets you set the foreground and background colors, the module size, the quiet zone, and the QR version
- Exports the finished code as a PNG or an SVG

## Key facts
- UTM parameters supported: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term
- Error correction levels: L (~7%), M (~15%), Q (~25%), H (~30%)
- Export: PNG at 300, 600, 900 or 1200 px; SVG
- QR codes are generated in the browser; your URLs and logos never leave your device. No accounts, no tracking of generated codes (the page itself loads Google Analytics)
- License: MIT
